QEVA SANDBOX CORE 1 — portable experiment specifications

A sandbox can reveal behavior. It cannot silently upgrade behavior into truth.
DECLARE the rule, parameters and arithmetic.
REPRODUCE from the exact declared interpreter revision and parameters.
LABEL observations, conjectures, proofs and counterexamples distinctly.
PRESERVE FAILURE: budget stops and negative results remain information.

FORMAT
UTF-8 JSON, schema_version qeva-sandbox/1. Required fields: id, revision, title,
kernel_ref, parameters, concept_refs, claim, provenance, runs.
Claim has label, text, verification. verification must be unreviewed in a personal lab.
A user choosing theorem or proof is not verification.
A run has id, at, result, note. Result has engine, kernel_ref, arithmetic, parameters,
status, series, summary. Engine reference: qeva-kernels/1. Retain state at step zero.
Each run freezes its own parameters even when the editor changes afterwards.

REFERENCE INTERPRETERS
qeva:kernel:affine@1
  x[n+1] = a*x[n]+b, binary64 multiplication before addition, no fused multiply-add.
  -4<=a<=4, -10<=b<=10, -10<=x0<=10, integer 1<=steps<=128.
  Series entries [n,x]; result status complete or numeric-limit.

qeva:kernel:logistic@1
  x[n+1] = (r*x[n])*(1-x[n]); same for y. y0=x0+delta.
  binary64, explicit operation order. No clamp or noise.
  0<=r<=4, 0<=x0<=1, 0<=delta<=0.05, x0+delta<=1.
  Integer 1<=steps<=512. Series entries [n,x,y].
  Report maximum/final separation and first separation strictly greater than 0.1
  (null when not reached). Finite trajectories are not a chaos theorem.

qeva:kernel:collatz@1
  T(n)=n/2 if even; 3*n+1 if odd. Exact positive integer arithmetic.
  Start is a decimal STRING of at most 30 digits, no sign or leading zero.
  Integer 1<=steps<=1024. States exported as decimal strings: [index,"integer"].
  Stop at 1, the step budget or before storing an integer longer than 512 digits.
  Status reached-one, step-budget or digit-budget. Peak is an exact decimal string.
  The 512-digit guard is defensive; the current bounded positive-start/step range
  may stop earlier. A finite budget stop is inconclusive, not a counterexample.
  Approximate plot coordinates are presentation only; retain the exact state table.

Import re-executes supported runs and compares full results. A mismatch is rejected
for investigation, not repaired silently. Unknown versions need their own interpreter.
Preserve source JSON and the full release to retain that interpreter.

SHARING
Full JSON includes all runs. The compact #lab=base64url specification link omits the
run journal, includes declared text, is not encrypted and creates no server upload.
A fork has a new ID and parent ID/revision; it retains the evidence journal.
At most 50 runs, 20 local drafts; file import at most 2 MiB. Export before limits/reset.
No arbitrary user code executes. No account is required. No automatic canonicalization.

See sandbox.schema.json and ../docs/SANDBOX_FORMAT.md for field and implementation details.
